sn1.4:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.4:2.1: Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo || vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti || etaṃ bhayaṃ {maraṇe} pekkhamāno || puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahānīti || ||
sn1.4:3.1: Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo || vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti || etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno || lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho ti || ||
